> 第11章 叶灵儿（第1页）
楚云坐在一棵参天古树下，正烤着一只野兔。
这里距离北灵学院已经只剩下数十里路了。
“小娘们，别跑了，这荒山野岭你是逃不出我手掌心的。”
只见一名白衣少女，正朝着楚云这里跑来。
她年龄大约十四五岁，身材娇小，但是容貌极美，活脱脱一个小萝莉。
当看见坐在大树下的楚云后，她一把将楚云抱住。
就在这时，一名身材强壮的黑袍青年，冲到楚云身前，大声道：“小子，我劝你不要多管闲事。”
楚云面无表情地烤着野兔，但是声音却冰冷道：“三息之内消失在我眼前，否则，死！”
黑袍青年一愣，随即上下打量楚云。
当发现楚云身上没有丝毫修为气息后，他瞬间大笑了起来。
“你一个没有修为的废物，也想英雄救美，我看你是活得不耐烦了。”
随着这话响起，他伸出手臂抓住楚云的衣领，想要将楚云提起来。
但是不管他怎么用力，楚云都纹丝不动。
随着这话响起，楚云抬起手臂，一拳打在黑袍青年的胸口上。
随着一道沉闷的声音响起，只见黑袍青年的胸口，直接被楚云打穿。
“小子，你敢杀我，我爹不会放过你的。”
黑袍青年一脸怨毒地看着楚云，最后笔直倒地。
楚云杀死黑袍青年后，若无其事地继续烤野兔。

此时的她，已经看出楚云是个高手。
楚云淡淡道：“用不着谢我，是他想找死。”
白衣少女略微沉吟，便看着楚云问道：“公子是什么修为？”
白衣少女道：“不瞒公子，刚才你打死的那个人，是北灵学院内院大长老的儿子，他仗着他爹是长老，所以经常欺负学院里面的女生。”
“现在公子将他打死，他爹肯定会找公子的麻烦，所以我劝公子你赶紧走。”
楚云挑眉问道：“如此说来，你也是北灵学院的人了？”
“对，不过我只是一个外院学员。”
楚云道：“正好，我也要去北灵学院，你能不能给我带路？”
白衣少女一脸吃惊，道：“公子，你要去北灵学院？”
白衣少女慌了，连忙道：“公子，我刚才不是给你说了吗？你打死的那个人，是北灵学院内院大长老的儿子，你要是去北灵学院，不是自投罗网吗？”
白衣少女道：“公子，虽然我看不出你的修为有多高，但是肯定不会超过玄武境。”
“但是你知道吗？卢浩他爹的修为已经达到天武境，他要杀你易如反掌，所以我还是劝你尽快离开这里。”
楚云看出对方单纯善良，知道对方是在担心自己。
天武境又如何，他现在已经达到人剑合一境界。
只要他想逃走，就算天武境也未必能够留住他。
当下笑道：“人是我打死的，就算要找麻烦，也是找我的麻烦，跟你没有关系，你只管带路就行。”
见楚云坚持要去，白衣少女道：“好吧，反正我已经给你提过醒了，既然你执意要去，那我给你带路。”
楚云拿起烤好的兔肉，闻了闻，道：“不急，吃完兔肉再走不迟。”
他赶了几天的路，到现在都还没有吃东西。
见楚云还要吃东西，白衣少女只好坐下等他。

白衣少女低声道：“我叫叶灵儿。”

I have been pretending to be trash for three years, and now I am invincible. The latest chapter_Chapter 11 Ye Ling'er Page 1_I have been pretending to be trash for three years, and I am now invincible. Mr. Zhang Ming_Hot Novel Network
> Chapter 11 Ye Linger (Page 1)
Chu Yun was sitting under a towering old tree, roasting a hare.
There are only dozens of miles left from Beiling College.
"Little girls, don't run away. You can't escape my grasp in these barren mountains and mountains."
I saw a girl in white running towards Chu Yun.
She is about fourteen or fifteen years old, petite in stature, but very beautiful in appearance, just like a little loli.
When she saw Chu Yun sitting under the big tree, she hugged Chu Yun.
At this moment, a strong young man in black robe rushed to Chu Yun and said loudly: "Boy, I advise you not to meddle in other people's business."
Chu Yun roasted the hare with an expressionless face, but his voice was cold: "Disappear in front of my eyes within three breaths, otherwise, die!"
The young man in black robe was stunned for a moment, then looked Chu Yun up and down.
When he discovered that Chu Yun didn't have any aura of cultivation on his body, he laughed instantly.
"You are a loser with no cultivation, but you still want to be a hero and save the beauty. I think you are impatient with life."
As these words rang out, he stretched out his arm and grabbed Chu Yun's collar, trying to lift Chu Yun up.
But no matter how hard he tried, Chu Yun couldn't move at all.
As these words rang out, Chu Yun raised his arm and punched the young man in black robe on the chest.
As a dull voice sounded, the young man in black robe was punched through the chest by Chu Yun.
"Boy, if you dare to kill me, my father will not let you go."
The young man in black robe looked at Chu Yun with a look of resentment, and finally fell straight to the ground.
After Chu Yun killed the young man in black robe, he continued to roast the hare as if nothing had happened.
At this time, she had already seen that Chu Yun was a master.
Chu Yun said calmly: "No need to thank me, he is looking for death."
The girl in white pondered for a moment, then looked at Chu Yun and asked, "What kind of cultivation is the young master?"
The girl in white said: "To be fair, sir, the man you killed just now is the son of the elder of the inner courtyard of Beiling Academy. He often bullies the girls in the academy because his father is the elder."
"Now that Young Master beats him to death, his father will definitely cause trouble for Young Master, so I advise Young Master to leave as soon as possible."
Chu Yun raised his eyebrows and asked, "So, you are also from Beiling College?"
"Yes, but I'm just a student from the outer academy."
Chu Yun said: "Just in time, I am also going to Beiling College. Can you show me the way?"
The girl in white looked surprised and said: "Sir, are you going to Beiling Academy?"
The girl in white panicked and said quickly: "Sir, didn't I tell you just now? The man you beat to death was the son of the elder of the inner courtyard of Beiling Academy. If you go to Beiling Academy, wouldn't you be throwing yourself into a trap?"
The girl in white said: "Sir, although I can't tell how high your cultivation level is, it will definitely not exceed the Xuanwu realm."
"But do you know? Lu Hao's father's cultivation has reached the Tianwu realm. It would be easy for him to kill you, so I advise you to leave here as soon as possible."
Chu Yun saw that the other party was pure and kind, and knew that the other party was worried about him.
So what about the Tianwu realm, he has now reached the realm where man and sword merge into one.
As long as he wants to escape, even the Tianwu realm may not be able to keep him.
Then he smiled and said: "I beat him to death. Even if he is looking for trouble, he is looking for trouble with me. It has nothing to do with you. You just lead the way."
Seeing that Chu Yun insisted on going, the girl in white said: "Okay, anyway, I have warned you. Since you insist on going, then I will show you the way."
Chu Yun picked up the roasted rabbit meat, smelled it, and said, "Don't worry, it's not too late to leave after eating the rabbit meat."
He has been traveling for several days and has not eaten yet.
Seeing that Chu Yun wanted to eat, the girl in white had no choice but to sit down and wait for him.
The girl in white whispersSaid: "My name is Ye Ling'er."
